name: SkinTokens Rigging
author: PolyKit / VAST-AI-Research adapter
description: Generate a mesh-specific skeleton and skin weights for animation-ready GLB assets.

download.note: SkinTokens checkpoints are approximately 1.6 GB. Qwen3 model metadata (~16 MB) is fetched automatically on first load.

models.name: SkinTokens TokenRig
models.note: Both SkinVAE and TokenRig checkpoints are required; Qwen3 metadata is fetched automatically on first load.

params_schema.label: Preserve Source Mesh
params_schema.tooltip: Keep the input mesh materials and textures while transferring generated skin weights.

zh-CN.label: 保留原始网格
zh-CN.tooltip: 保留输入网格的材质和纹理，只转移生成的骨骼权重。

params_schema.label: Top K
params_schema.tooltip: Token sampling limit. Lower values are more deterministic.

zh-CN.label: Top K
zh-CN.tooltip: 采样候选数量上限。数值越低越稳定。

params_schema.label: Temperature
params_schema.tooltip: Sampling temperature. Lower values reduce variation.

zh-CN.label: 温度
zh-CN.tooltip: 采样温度。数值越低变化越小。

params_schema.label: Repetition Penalty
params_schema.tooltip: Penalty applied to repeated skeleton tokens.

zh-CN.label: 重复惩罚
zh-CN.tooltip: 对重复骨骼 token 应用的惩罚。

params_schema.label: Beam Count
params_schema.tooltip: Beam search width. Higher values use more time and memory.

zh-CN.label: Beam 数量
zh-CN.tooltip: Beam search 宽度。数值越高越耗时和显存。

params_schema.label: Voxel Postprocess
params_schema.tooltip: Apply SkinTokens' voxel-based skin cleanup. This costs extra time and memory.

zh-CN.label: 体素后处理
zh-CN.tooltip: 应用 SkinTokens 的体素蒙皮清理，会增加耗时和显存。

zh-CN.name: SkinTokens 自动绑定
zh-CN.description: 为输入网格生成适配自身形状的骨架与蒙皮权重，输出可继续制作动画的 GLB。
